title: AR4: closed-loop assurance architecture (ADR-0010) + A5 enforcement wiring (CI evidence artifacts + release-blocking readiness)
goal: Synthesize the closed-loop assurance architecture as ADR-0010 and land its first enforcement mechanics, closing AR1 gap A5 (the assurance system was diagnostic, not enforcing: master had zero required checks, the lite lanes ran none of P1-P7, no nightly-adversarial workflow existed, scripts/icc_traces was git-ignored so CI emitted no oracle evidence, and icc readiness=100 was a workstation verdict). The ADR ratifies the six-part model: (1) single source of truth = the language-surface manifest + grammar drive all generative pressure; (2) evidence = every gate emits runtime_event/test_result traces and coverage is execution-backed only; (3) three independent oracle families = differential (RAW output) / reference-free properties / native-VM-wasm parity contracts; (4) the aviation-model escape-analysis feedback loop (ledger .swarm/P8_ESCAPE_ANALYSIS.md); (5) enforcement = branch protection + required lanes + release-blocking icc readiness at the cut SHA; (6) the coverage-of-coverage matrix as a maintained artifact whose EMPTY cells are burned down by release. Maps all 13 AR1 gaps (A1-A13) to closure mechanism, pillar/branch, and owning release.
next_actions: ADR-0010 documents the closed-loop model and the gap->closure->owning-release map (v1.3.5: A5+A1+A2/A3/A4/A6/A7 via P8/a1; v1.4: A8 TSan-required, A10-A12, A13; v1.5: full race matrix; AR3: A9 ICC registry-aware liveness).

ci.yml: append an 'Upload ICC evidence traces' step to unix-matrix that uploads scripts/icc_traces/* and the .icc oracle-view dirs as a per-lane artifact (if: always(), if-no-files-found: ignore) so oracle evidence survives CI teardown. Append-only, distinct from the a1 coverage step.

release.yml: add release-readiness-gate — regenerate traces at the tagged SHA (build, run_language_coverage.sh, run_vm_parity.sh), icc architecture-verify --emit-trace, and the canonical run_v1_3_readiness.sh + explicit score==100 assertion; publish-release needs it. Blocking on tag push, advisory on workflow_dispatch dry-run, loud-error-block (never fail-open) when ICC is unavailable.

CONTRIBUTING.md: document the branch-protection required-check baseline (lite lanes + linux-x64-asan-ubsan + identity-guard required; xla/cuda/quantum-macos advisory) and the release-blocking readiness gate + ICC_BIN requirement. The protection itself is applied in repo settings.
acceptance: docs/design/adr/0010-closed-loop-assurance.md exists in house ADR style with plain-text status labels and resolves its internal references.
actionlint reports no new structural errors on ci.yml or release.yml; the release-readiness-gate bash steps carry zero shellcheck findings.
publish-release depends on release-readiness-gate; the gate fails the release on any verdict but ready/100 at the cut SHA and never fail-opens when ICC is absent on a tag push.
CONTRIBUTING.md names the required-check set and the release-blocking readiness gate; no consumer names or AI attribution in any changed text.
Build is unaffected (docs + workflow only); run_icc_smoke.sh stays green in the worktree.
found_by: AR1 assurance-architecture audit (gap A5 — no CI enforcement; master unprotected; traces git-ignored)
ux_payoff: Turns readiness=100 from a workstation opinion into a repository-enforced, release-blocking property: a silent-wrong regression must now defeat three independent oracle families, survive the nightly pillars, and pass a release-blocking readiness gate before it can ship.
